hunt.justification: Reduced staffing during holiday periods increases the time from detection to response. This hunt proactively identifies the most dangerous access paths and enables immediate containment to maintain resilience.

stages.name: Command and Control via Multi-hop Proxy

scenario.summary: Organizations face increased risk during periods of reduced staffing when capacity for incident response and change management is limited. Adversaries exploit these windows using phishing or vulnerability exploitation, often masking their presence with multi-hop proxies to complicate detection and eviction.

meta.rationale: The lead query identifies any host with a critical vulnerability. The gate ensures that deep behavioral queries only run when the organization's current operational capacity necessitates proactive intervention on high-risk assets.
meta.hypothesis: An adversary exploits unpatched internet-facing vulnerabilities or phishes users to establish multi-hop proxy C2, banking on reduced holiday staffing to delay detection and response.

hunt.name: External Access and Proxy-Based Command and Control
hunt.description: Adversaries exploit reduced staffing levels during holidays to conduct stealthy intrusions. This hunt identifies critical unpatched vulnerabilities and uses an agent to evaluate their impact on the organization's external attack surface. If exposure is confirmed, it fans out to look for behavioral indicators of phishing execution and multi-hop proxy connections (Tor/ORBs) that bypass standard detection rules. An agent weighs the combined risk of exposure and suspicious activity to identify hosts that require immediate isolation during periods of reduced operational capacity.

config.content: SELECT device_uid, cve_uid, title, severity_id, affected_package_name, last_seen FROM hb_vulnerability_finding WHERE severity_id >= {{critical_severity_threshold}} AND status != 'suppressed' AND last_seen >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify active critical vulnerabilities that could serve as initial access points during reduced staffing periods.
config.expected_signal: A list of hostnames with unpatched critical flaws. Silence means no critical vulnerabilities were reported in the window.

primitive_config.label: Identify critical vulnerabilities
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_uid, cve_uid, title, severity_id, affected_package_name, last_seen FROM hb_vulnerability_finding WHERE severity_id >= {{critical_severity_threshold}} AND status != 'suppressed' AND last_seen >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
primitive_config.expected: A list of hostnames with unpatched critical flaws. Silence means no critical vulnerabilities were reported in the window.

config.objective: Review the identified vulnerabilities and decide if they represent a high-risk exposure path (e.g. exploitable, internet-facing, or widely distributed) that justifies running behavioral checks.
config.description: Determine if the identified vulnerabilities warrant the expense of a behavioral hunt based on current organizational risk appetite.
config.expected_signal: A verdict on whether to proceed with deep behavioral analysis.
config.success_criteria: A clear recommendation to continue to behavior analysis or end the hunt.

config.question: the evaluate-risk verdict identifies high-impact exposure or unmitigated critical vulnerabilities
config.condition: the evaluate-risk verdict identifies high-impact exposure or unmitigated critical vulnerabilities
config.description: Halt the hunt if no high-risk exposure is identified, preserving analyst and agent resources.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, process_cmd_line, parent_process_name, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND instr(',' || '{{phishing_parents}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(parent_process_name) || ',') > 0 AND instr(',' || '{{interpreter_children}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_name) || ',') > 0 AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Find instances where common productivity apps spawn interpreters, indicating potential phishing execution.
config.expected_signal: A parent-child process match. Silence indicates no common phishing execution chains were detected.

primitive_config.label: Detect phishing execution patterns
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, process_cmd_line, parent_process_name, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND instr(',' || '{{phishing_parents}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(parent_process_name) || ',') > 0 AND instr(',' || '{{interpreter_children}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_name) || ',') > 0 AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
primitive_config.expected: A parent-child process match. Silence indicates no common phishing execution chains were detected.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, dst_endpoint_ip, dst_endpoint_port, COUNT(*) AS connections, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_network_connection WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND activity_id = 1 AND instr(',' || '{{proxy_ports}}' || ',', ',' || CAST(dst_endpoint_port AS TEXT) || ',') > 0 AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 HAVING connections < 50
config.description: Identify hosts connecting to common proxy or Tor infrastructure, which may indicate multi-hop C2.
config.expected_signal: Rare connections to proxy-associated ports. Silence means no direct proxy traffic was observed on those ports.

primitive_config.label: Detect anomalous proxy connections
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, dst_endpoint_ip, dst_endpoint_port, COUNT(*) AS connections, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_network_connection WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND activity_id = 1 AND instr(',' || '{{proxy_ports}}' || ',', ',' || CAST(dst_endpoint_port AS TEXT) || ',') > 0 AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 HAVING connections < 50
primitive_config.expected: Rare connections to proxy-associated ports. Silence means no direct proxy traffic was observed on those ports.

config.objective: Determine if any host with a critical vulnerability is also showing signs of phishing execution or multi-hop proxy C2. Use the first agent's assessment of exposure to weight the behavioral findings.
config.description: Correlate exposure risk with behavioral evidence to identify confirmed threats requiring immediate response.
config.expected_signal: A per-host verdict of malicious, suspicious, or benign.
config.success_criteria: A per-host verdict citing specific rows from the process and network surfaces.

config.question: the triage-intrusion verdict is malicious for at least one host
config.condition: the triage-intrusion verdict is malicious for at least one host
config.description: Automatically isolate high-confidence threats to mitigate impact during reduced staffing periods.
Neutralize the threat immediately when the security team is at reduced capacity.
config.instructions: Isolate the host to prevent lateral movement and further C2 communication while the analyst completes the investigation.

config.description: Manually validate suspicious findings and confirm isolation actions.
config.instructions: Review the agent triage findings; prioritize hosts where critical vulnerabilities intersect with rare behavioral alerts. Confirm or revert isolation actions.

config.description: Finalize the hunt and record exposure findings for patching.
config.instructions: Document findings, update the risk profile for the remaining holiday period, and ensure vulnerable hosts identified in the lead are scheduled for patching.
